idx_events_nonphantom_stream_sequence.name: idx_events_nonphantom_stream_sequence
idx_events_nonphantom_stream_sequence.where:
NOT (
  type='AttentionEpisodeObserved'
  AND COALESCE(json_extract(payload,'$.capture_version'),'') IN ('attention-v1','attention-v2')
  AND COALESCE(json_extract(payload,'$.terminal_type'),'')='idle_timeout'
  AND COALESCE(json_extract(payload,'$.terminal_ref'),'')=''
  AND COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(payload,'$.active_ms') AS REAL),-1)=30000
  AND COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(payload,'$.idle_ms') AS REAL),-1)>=30000
  AND COALESCE(json_extract(payload,'$.surface'),'')<>''
  AND COALESCE(json_extract(payload,'$.context'),'')=COALESCE(json_extract(payload,'$.surface'),'')||'-overview'
  AND COALESCE(json_type(payload,'$.visible_refs'),'')='array'
  AND json_array_length(payload,'$.visible_refs')=0
  AND COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(payload,'$.friction_score') AS REAL),0)<.45
  AND COALESCE(CAST(json_extract(payload,'$.outcome_weight') AS REAL),0)<.18
)

output_operation_slots_check_6.name: output_operation_slots_check_6
output_operation_slots_check_6.value: (attempt_ordinal=0 AND previous_slot_id IS NULL) OR (attempt_ordinal>0 AND previous_slot_id IS NOT NULL)

output_plan_revisions_check_5.name: output_plan_revisions_check_5
output_plan_revisions_check_5.value: (scope_kind='personal' AND organization_id IS NULL AND project_access_id IS NULL) OR (scope_kind='project' AND organization_id IS NOT NULL AND project_access_id IS NOT NULL)

output_provider_calls_check_2.name: output_provider_calls_check_2
output_provider_calls_check_2.value: used_microusd IS NULL OR typeof(used_microusd)='integer' AND used_microusd>=0

generation_study_lifecycle_holds.name: generation_study_lifecycle_holds
generation_study_lifecycle_holds.definition:
SELECT o.owner_id,o.operation_id FROM generation_study_operations o
 JOIN generation_study_reconciliations r ON r.operation_id=o.operation_id
 AND r.sequence=(SELECT MAX(sequence) FROM generation_study_reconciliations WHERE operation_id=o.operation_id)
 WHERE o.financial_policy_id IS NOT NULL AND
 (r.policy_id!=o.financial_policy_id OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM generation_study_financial_grants g WHERE g.grant_id=o.grant_id AND g.operation_id=o.operation_id AND g.owner_id=o.owner_id AND g.policy_id=r.policy_id AND json_extract(g.policy_json,'$.lifecycle.scope')=r.lifecycle_scope AND json_extract(g.policy_json,'$.lifecycle.liabilityOwner')=r.liability_owner AND json_extract(g.policy_json,'$.lifecycle.through')=r.lifecycle_through AND json_extract(g.policy_json,'$.lifecycle.maximumMicrousd')>=r.lifecycle_microusd) OR r.provider_settled!=1 OR r.remaining_uncertainty_microusd IS NOT 0 OR
 (r.lifecycle_closed=1 AND (r.lifecycle_microusd!=0 OR r.lifecycle_incurred_microusd IS NULL OR r.lifecycle_incurred_microusd>COALESCE((SELECT reserved_microusd FROM cost_budget_reservations WHERE reservation_id=o.lifecycle_reservation_id),0))) OR
 (r.lifecycle_closed=0 AND (r.lifecycle_through<=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') OR NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM cost_budget_reservations c WHERE c.reservation_id=o.lifecycle_reservation_id AND c.owner_id=o.owner_id AND c.status='active' AND c.reserved_microusd>=r.lifecycle_microusd))))
